#Create a vector with NAs in it
```{r}
x <- c(1, 2, NA, 10, 3)
is.na(x)
```
```{r}
x <- c(1, 2, 4, "NA", 5)  
bad <- is.na(x)  
print(bad)
```
```{r}
x[!bad]
```
```{r}

good
```

# Data Visualization Using ggplot2
# Install and load ggplot2
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mydata, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 5,
    fill = "skyblue",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
